title: docs(sdk): imageGenerate returns one image per call
author: Connectslide121

gist.summary: Corrected the SDK README: `imageGenerate` returns one image per call, not multiple images via an `n` option, since 5.1.0-alpha.12. The documented option is `responseFormat`, matching `ImageGenerateV1Options`.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden workspace, Polli points to a single image emerging from an SDK terminal beside an open README, with lime green (#ecf874) code-plants and a warm cream backdrop. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she wears tiny reading glasses and shares the scene with the terminal, in cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes.
